articles.title: Microsoft’s DLSS competitor is out for the Xbox Ally X and works in handheld mode
articles.essence: Microsoft is now rolling out Automatic Super Resolution (Auto SR), an upscaling technology that competes with Nvidia's DLSS, for the Xbox Ally X, Xbox Ally X20, and select Windows Copilot Plus PCs, the company announced today. Auto SR is also getting some new features alongside this official release.

articles.title: The VR Disney Plus app on Meta Quest now has 3D movies
articles.essence: Disney is bringing more than 60 3D movies to the Disney Plus app on Meta Quest. The movies will be available to Disney Plus subscribers as part of an updated Disney Plus app that's rolling out today.
